hero.title: Mahmoud Fathy
hero.body: Enterprise Blockchain engineer with deep experience in RWA tokenization and enterprise distributed ledger platforms. Proven experience across public and private blockchains, delivering production-ready solutions spanning smart contracts, backend services, frontend applications, and CI/CD automation. Polyglot, Tool-oriented mindset
about.title: About
about.body: I am a blockchain engineer with more than seven years of experience delivering production-ready distributed systems. My expertise includes smart contract development in multiple languages, RWA tokenization, and full-stack Web3 architecture across public and permissioned blockchains. I work with organizations to bridge traditional finance and decentralized technology through scalable, enterprise-grade solutions.
